item.title: Iran Receives Vance Letter, Signals No Shift in Peace Deal Terms
item.description: Iran received a letter sent by US Vice President JD Vance to its top security official, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, with one of the country’s top negotiators later suggesting Tehran’s positions on ending the war will not be compromised.

item.title: Who is Anil Menon? NASA astronaut on fourth spacewalk, ranks behind Sunita Williams among Indian-origin space walkers
item.description: NASA astronaut Anil Menon has a background spanning medicine, engineering, aviation and human spaceflight.

item.title: Why are Wall Street firms paying up to $100k a month for faster access to Trump's Truth Social posts? Any specific goal?
item.description: Bloomberg and two trading firms have reportedly agreed to pay Donald Trump’s Truth Social for faster access to his posts, as per Reuters. The company is already facing a lawsuit or faster access to government information. Here's why it is happening.

item.title: Your browsing history could decide how much you pay on purchases: 9 firms under US FTC scrutiny over personal data
item.description: The US FTC said it will examine whether consumers are charged different prices for the same product or service based on factors such as their browsing habits and personal data.

item.description: The response came after The New York Times reported that US intelligence agencies had concluded Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was a Chinese intelligence asset allegedly funneling information to Beijing.

item.title: Nitin Gadkari announces 120 kmph speed limit on expressways with 20% leeway, leaves internet divided: ‘Don't risk lives’
item.description: Nitin Gadkari attended an event where he announced a new speed limit on expressways. Many on the internet have expressed safety concerns over the revised speed limit.

item.title: Meet Nanotyrannus Jodi: Auction - The rare dinosaur once mistaken for a young T. rex that fetched $47.3 million
item.description: A rare Nanotyrannus skeleton named Jodi sold for $47.3 million at Sotheby's in New York, becoming the second-most expensive dinosaur fossil ever auctioned. Once mistaken for a juvenile T. rex, the specimen has reignited debate over private fossil ownership and scientific access.

item.title: Delhi liquor booking app: Book 9 litres of whisky, 18 litres of beer, but no home delivery - how to collect your order
item.description: Delhi's liquor booking app lets residents aged 25 and above order up to 9 litres of whisky and 18 litres of beer online. However, home delivery is unavailable. Customers must collect orders from selected DSIIDC outlets within 48 hours of payment.

item.title: Artificial rain, waterfall, glass skywalk: Statue of Unity to develop ₹12 crore rainforest to boost Gujarat tourism
item.description: Tourists would be able to experience a year-round monsoon at Gujarat's Statue of Unity with an upcoming rainforest set up. The project would be spread across 12 acre, featuring lush green, waterfall and more.

item.title: Who is Justice SK Kaul? What is former Supreme Court judge's new memoir 'Without Fear or Favour' about?
item.description: Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul’s memoir, Without Fear or Favour, recounts his nearly five decades in the Indian judiciary and examines Supreme Court judge appointments, executive influence and the Collegium. Kaul also reflects on his disagreements with former Chief Justice DY Chandrachud.

item.title: Six-year-old Madhya Pradesh boy wins Toyota Fortuner worth ₹50 lakh in ₹200 lucky draw
item.description: Medansh Raikwar, a resident of Seelampura, won the first prize in a lucky draw organised at Shri Sarkar Dham in Abhapuri. His grandmother, Kiran Raikwar, had purchased the coupon nearly a year ago and entered her grandson’s name in the draw

item.description: Goyal also defended the government's decision to withdraw from the China-backed Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), saying that joining the free trade bloc would have sounded the death knell for India's manufacturing ambitions.

item.title: Experts red-flag cancer drug price cuts as patented therapies see zero relief, markups exceed benchmark
item.description: Experts said there should be comprehensive, cost-based price controls covering all oncology therapies, permanent statutory margin caps across distribution channels and full scrutiny of company assistance programmes.

item.title: What is NVS-03? ISRO to launch satellite on October 30; Why NVS-02 was not successful? Key reasons explained
item.description: ISRO will launch the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard a GSLV rocket from Sriharikota at 11:51 PM on October 30. The satellite will support continuity of India’s regional navigation services and carries an indigenous atomic clock and an added L1 frequency band.

item.title: Stubble-burning fires drop 31% across six states as Delhi braces for winter
item.description: The decline comes at a critical point in the agricultural calendar, as stubble burning in neighbouring states is a seasonal contributor to worsening air quality in Delhi and the surrounding National Capital Region (NCR), particularly during winter.
